_allowed_clients_help: Only these computers can open the page. Add PC IP addresses or a whole subnet (e.g. 10.20.30.0/24). 127.0.0.1 = this server itself.
_access_key_help: Optional shared password. Leave empty to rely on the IP list only.
_roots_help: The ONLY folders the file browser can open. writable=true lets people save outputs there.
_cors_help: Only needed if index.html is hosted on GitHub Pages instead of opened from this server.
